name: cab.any/malta-transfers
title: any.cab
description: Fixed-price taxis and private transfers anywhere in Malta, 24/7: prices, quotes and bookings.

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: Per-km rate card for each vehicle on a date (EUR): base_cost, per_km, max_pax and luggage. price = base_cost + driving distance in km × per_km, minimum €20.00 per trip. Indicative only: an exact, bookable price depends on the driving distance of the trip.

date.description: Trip date YYYY-MM-DD (Malta). Defaults to today.

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Search hotels, addresses, towns and landmarks in Malta (Gozo and Comino are not served yet). Returns places with name, address and coordinates, in the same format a quote accepts for its from and to.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Fixed price for a private transfer between two places in Malta, for every vehicle that fits the group. Returns one offer per vehicle with price, max_pax, luggage, a price breakdown and a quote_id valid for 15 minutes.

from.description: Either the string "MLA" (Malta International Airport) or a place object from search_locations, passed as is.

name.description: Readable place name for the driver

to.description: Either the string "MLA" (Malta International Airport) or a place object from search_locations, passed as is.

name.description: Readable place name for the driver

pickup_at.description: Pickup time, Malta local, e.g. "2026-11-25T10:00" (or ISO 8601 with offset). At least 48 hours ahead.

pax.description: Number of passengers, including children. Only vehicles that fit the whole group are quoted.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Book a quote for the passenger. Returns booking_id and a payment_url for the traveller; nothing is charged until they pay there, and the booking is confirmed only after payment. Retrying with the same idempotency_key returns the same booking.

idempotency_key.description: 8-100 characters; reuse it when retrying the same booking

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Status of a booking: awaiting_payment, paid, confirmed (with confirmation_code) or expired.
